subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should the Gateway permanently expose optional `installDaemon` so an embedded remote client may own daemon installation while omitted requests retain normal onboarding behavior?
rationale: The code is mechanically coherent and preserves omission semantics, but adding a generated cross-client RPC parameter commits the project to an externally consumable setup-policy capability.

options.title: Approve the optional RPC control
options.body: Accept `installDaemon` as the bounded embedded-client ownership seam and merge once the current-head checks finish.

options.title: Split the lifecycle fix
options.body: Land only the non-exiting runtime and cancellation fixes, then discuss daemon-installation control as a separate protocol proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional RPC control
